title: ISP Tracking & DNS Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request privacy information from your ISP about DNS tracking, monitoring practices, and data collection policies.
description: A professional letter template to request information from your internet service provider about their DNS tracking practices, data collection policies, and monitoring activities. Helps you understand what data your ISP collects and how to protect your privacy.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Introduction
sections.content:
Re: Privacy Information Request - DNS Tracking and Monitoring Practices
Account Number: [Your Account Number]

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing as a customer of [ISP Company Name] to request information about your company's DNS tracking, internet monitoring, and data collection practices as they relate to my internet service.

sections.heading: DNS Privacy Information Request
sections.content:
I would like to understand the following aspects of your DNS and privacy practices:

1. DNS Logging: Do you log DNS queries made through your DNS servers? If so, what information is recorded and for how long is it retained?

2. DNS Filtering: Do you filter, block, or redirect DNS queries? Please provide details about any content filtering or DNS manipulation.

3. Third-Party Sharing: Do you share DNS query data or browsing information with third parties, advertisers, or government agencies?

4. Data Collection: What specific data do you collect about my internet usage, including websites visited, connection times, and bandwidth usage?

sections.heading: Monitoring and Tracking Practices
sections.content:
Please provide information about your monitoring practices:

1. Traffic Analysis: Do you perform deep packet inspection (DPI) or analyze the content of my internet traffic?

2. Behavioral Tracking: Do you create profiles of customer internet usage patterns or browsing habits?

3. Advertising Programs: Do you participate in any advertising programs that use customer data?

4. Opt-Out Options: What options do I have to opt out of data collection, tracking, or sharing programs?

sections.heading: Privacy Protection Options
sections.content:
I am also interested in learning about:

1. Alternative DNS: Can I use third-party DNS servers (such as Cloudflare, Quad9, or Google DNS) without restrictions?

2. DNS over HTTPS/TLS: Do you support DNS over HTTPS (DoH) or DNS over TLS (DoT) for enhanced privacy?

3. Privacy Settings: Are there account settings I can adjust to enhance my privacy?

4. Data Deletion: Can I request deletion of stored DNS logs or browsing data?

sections.heading: Legal Rights and Response Request
sections.content:
Under applicable privacy laws and as your customer, I believe I have the right to understand how my data is collected and used. Please provide:

1. Your current privacy policy and any recent updates
2. Written responses to the questions above
3. Information about my rights regarding data collection and sharing
4. Contact information for further privacy-related inquiries

I would appreciate a response within 30 days. If you need additional information to process this request, please contact me at [Your Email] or [Your Phone Number].

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this privacy matter. I look forward to your prompt response and to better understanding your privacy practices.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Account Holder (if different)]
